description: A_omega step 3, u=0 calibration leg: numeric verification of GGM eq (48) for 4_1 at the substrate ray. Exact convergent G-series side vs order-3 exact asymptotic side; integer connection matrix M_I(0) DERIVED (not OCR-read, not fitted) and cross-checked against the Conjecture-10 W-transpose shape. Records the structural finding that the u=0 non-perturbative channel is ~1e-164 at the substrate while the deformed odd datum is O(1).

data.physics_note: u=0 non-perturbative channel invisible at substrate (|q~|~1e-164); measured deformed Im V_b ~ 0.0585 is O(1); A_omega must be deformation-carried (u != 0)
data.verdict: GGM eq-(48) bridge verified numerically at the substrate ray for 4_1 at u=0: the exact side (Theorem-9-certified G-series = the GK state-integral factorization) equals the integer-dressed asymptotic side with DERIVED integer matrix M_I(0) = [[4, -4], [4, 4]] (prefactor 3^(-1/4)/4 selected by integrality; held-out residual 7.64e-6 within the order-3 truncation estimate 5.8e-5; Conjecture-10 shape X = [[0, -4], [4, -4]] integer: True). Structural finding: at u=0 the substrate non-perturbative channel is |q~| ~ 1e-164 (invisible), while the measured deformed Im V_b ~ 0.0585 is O(1) — A_omega is deformation-carried. Calibration leg only; no A_omega identification claimed. Scope-(a); no fit; no c_k wired.
